title: Negated circuit literal
statement: For a circuit literal $l$ on $n$ variables, its associated literal over circuit variables is the negative occurrence of input $l_{\mathrm{idx}}$ if $l$ is positive, and the positive occurrence of that input if $l$ is negated.
hypotheses_covered: $l$ is a circuit literal on $n$ variables
